body.message: Dear fam,As part of the company’s initiative to recognise and reward the referral efforts of our Agents and Sales Leaders, fam has introduced a new referral system called the Mentorship Program.Mentorship Program replaces Internal Referral for agent referrals.The Mentorship Program is now the dedicated channel for referring Agents to fam. Therefore, all referrals for the Property Advisor position must be submitted through the Mentorship Program.Please note that referrals submitted through the Internal Referral channel will not be considered under the Mentorship Program and will not be eligible for its incentives.The Mentorship Program is designed to reward mentors for bringing quality talent to fam. The mentor will remain eligible for the applicable incentives for as long as the referred Agent remains with fam, in line with the program terms.Correct referral submission is essentialTo ensure that your referral is correctly recognised and that you remain eligible for the applicable incentives, it is essential that the referral is properly recorded in the system from the beginning.The Mentorship Program is now available directly from the main page of the Agents CRM.How to submit your referralPlease follow the below steps:CRM → Money → Mentorship Program → Add Referral → CreateKindly refer to the attached screenshots for guidance. Please do not use the Internal Referral channel when referring candidates for Property Advisor position.Submitting the referral through the correct channel is essential to ensure that the referral can be properly tracked, validated, and recognised for the applicable Mentorship Program incentives.Thank you for your cooperation and support in ensuring that all referrals are submitted correctly.Best regards,-- Zorica Maric SayahTalent Acquisition Manager,M: +971526770265Visit: www.famproperties.comGrab a copyThe Art of Real Estate InvestmentEmpowering Smarter DecisionsStay connected Stay ahead of the property market.
